supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:28 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 sent 640,000,221 bytes to the internal proxy at 10.40.20.30 over port 8080; the connection lasted about 12 seconds.
A separate nearby connection from FILE-NWD-01 to the same proxy carried 1,220 bytes from the origin and 25,557 bytes in response.

The observed transfer volume is consistent in scale with the organization's documented several-hundred-megabyte offsite backup uploads, but the available network record does not identify the application or destination service.

known_telemetry_limitations: FILE-NWD-01 winsec and Sysmon logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, including the alerted activity.
PROXY-NWD-01 proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so the proxy request's destination, URL, account, and disposition are unavailable.
The available Zeek connection record shows traffic from FILE-NWD-01 to the internal proxy, not the ultimate external recipient.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer reached an external destination or which destination service received it.
Whether the transfer was performed by the approved StratoSafe backup agent or another process or service.
What data was transferred, whether it was authorized, and whether the transfer completed successfully.
Whether the nearby service-ticket request or interactive RDP activity on FILE-NWD-01 was related to this transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs, including request destination, URL or CONNECT target, authentication identity, and byte counts for the transfer.
Obtain FILE-NWD-01 process and application telemetry for the transfer time, including the process responsible and its command line.
Correlate the transfer with StratoSafe agent logs and backup job records, and verify the destination against the approved backup service.
Investigate the separate service-ticket request and RDP activity in a separate ticket; establish whether either is related only if additional evidence supports a link.
unrelated_findings: A Kerberos service-ticket request for FILE-NWD-01$ as svc-archive came from 139.162.174.124. This record alone does not establish a successful logon or a connection to the alerted transfer. (T040-00193)

nora.blake's workstation launched mstsc.exe to FILE-NWD-01, and a corresponding RDP connection was observed. This is outside the stated remote-administration practice and should be reviewed separately. (T040-00098, T040-00103)
